ValidationRule.description: Mandating 'Is Real Form Required?' when REaL Form / Event ID is entered.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), !isChanged(IDR_Additional_Correspondence_reviewed__c), !isChanged(IDR_Document_Count__c), AND( NOT( ISNEW() ), NOT( ISBLANK(IDR_Real_Form_Ref_No__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(IDR_Real_Form_Req__c,'No'), ISBLANK(TEXT(IDR_Real_Form_Req__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A REaL Form ID has been recorded against this complaint. Please ensure you include a value in the 'Is a REaL Form required?' field by clicking the 'Link REaL Form' button located at the top of the screen.
